title: Ordinary qcqs condensed pushforward preserves filtered colimits
statement: For a commutative condensed coefficient ring Λ, a qcqs scheme morphism f:X→Y, and a small filtered diagram D of internal Λ-module sheaves on X, the ordinary direct image f_* preserves the colimit of D. Internal module objects and inverse/direct image are as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. The index category has the same universe size as the sheaf-module category.

source.place: Lemma 5.3(1), degree-zero filtered continuity and scalar localization; agent categorical consequence

proof.text: Place the diagram in degree zero. Every single complex is its own good truncation at zero. The canonical continuity cocone is therefore colimiting, by transport of the ordinary complex colimit.

Apply condensed_qcqs_pushforward_continuity in degree zero. Its comparison isomorphism makes derived pushforward followed by zeroth homology preserve this cocone. The explicit natural isomorphism on single complexes identifies the composite with the original left-exact ordinary pushforward.

    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
